remarks: Brand-New Luxury Construction at The South Water Collection a boutique offering high-end townhomes designed to elevate coastal living in Greenwich. Offers 4,000 square feet of refined coastal living, thoughtfully designed to balance elegance, comfort, and modern functionality. Featuring 6 bedrooms and 5.5 designer bathrooms. The sun filled home features 9 foot ceilings throughout a sophisticated living area anchored by a gas fireplace, and a chef's kitchen appointed with quartz countertops and custom cabinetry. The home includes a luxury primary suite with a spa inspired bath, generous closet space, and a serene, private setting . The finished lower level provides a 6th bedroom, additional recreation space suited for media, fitness, 4th level offers an office suite with 5th bedroom +. A two car garage and curated finishes throughout complete this exceptional offering within the South Water Collection. Great location, close to local restaurants and shops!
